title: eo.user.hydration_index
description: Optional audit breadcrumb event in the user's user room recording the metadata of an external khora.hydration.v1.khr file the user produced or received (SPEC §21.6). Pure metadata — never includes the encryption key, the passphrase, the salt, or any payload bytes. Lets the user identify which file is which from any device without compromising any key.

key_fingerprint.description: Base64-encoded 8-byte SHA-256 prefix of the derived encryption key. Public, non-sensitive identifier — lets the user match a held key to a stored file before attempting decryption. Wrong-key attempts fail at fingerprint compare without exposing the payload.

key_mode.description: Key derivation mode the file uses.

split.description: Present only when key_mode == 'split'. Records the Shamir scheme parameters; never any share value.

scope.description: Rooms covered by the file and the as_of_event per room.

as_of_event.description: Map of room_id → Matrix event ID at which that room's bundle slice was captured.

signed_by_device.description: Optional Matrix device ID that Ed25519-signed the file.

storage_hint.description: Optional human-readable note about where the file is stored, e.g. 'Ledger NAS, /backups/khora/2026-05-06.khr'. Pure UX hint; never load-bearing.
